about.text: Front-end / Full-stack developer with practical experience in building web applications from design to deployment. Education: Successfully completed the full course and obtained a front-end developer certificate from Beetroot Academy (2025). Personal project (‘Home Accounting’): Independently developing a fully-fledged web application. Front-end: React.js, Tailwind CSS (alpha version deployed and running). Back-end and Infrastructure: I set up a Linux server for development myself, used Docker and deployed a PostgreSQL database. Commercial / Freelance experience: Successfully completed a commissioned project to develop a Telegram bot and create an admin panel to manage it. Personal CV: Created my own CV page using React.js programming skills, i18n for multilingual support, and third-party libraries. Stack: HTML/CSS/SASS, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React.js, Vue.js, Tailwind, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git / GitHub Actions, Linux.
